task_message:
Case F26: segment the fibrous soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 271x271x265 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The segmentation is complete.

**Summary:**
- **Finding:** A large, markedly T2-hyperintense fusiform soft-tissue mass in the anterolateral (patient right) subcutaneous/perifascial compartment of the distal limb, with a superficial extension reaching the skin surface and tapering cranio-caudally.
- **Method:** Seeded with a single positive point at the lesion core (axial 100/104), refined once, and verified slice-by-slice in all three planes.
- **Result:** 52.0 mL, single connected component, extent axial 74–137, coronal 118–170, sagittal 150–194 mm. Automatic candidates (C1–C5) were reviewed and rejected as perilesional fat/edema, skin-surface signal and a vessel, not tumor.
- **Confidence:** medium — boundary conforms to the bright lesion margin everywhere; residual uncertainty only at the inferior tip, which lies in an MRI stripe artifact that obscures the tissue there.
